name: HCMC Marathon (Ho Chi Minh City Marathon)
short_description: The HCMC Marathon is a full marathon, half marathon, and 10km race held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam on January 17, 2027.
ai_summary: The HCMC Marathon is a road race organized by Pulse Active in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, scheduled for January 17, 2027. It offers three distance options: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, and a 10km race, all starting from 30/4 Park on Le Duan Street. Registration is currently open for runners interested in participating.

faqs.question: When is the HCMC Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The HCMC Marathon is scheduled to take place on January 17, 2027. It is organized by Pulse Active and held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, starting from 30/4 Park on Le Duan Street. Runners should plan their travel and training around this confirmed date.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the HCMC Marathon?
faqs.answer: The HCMC Marathon offers three race distances for participants to choose from: a full marathon at 42.195km, a half marathon at 21.1km, and a shorter 10km race. This range allows both experienced marathoners and newer runners to find a suitable distance.

faqs.question: Where does the HCMC Marathon start?
faqs.answer: The race starts at 30/4 Park, located on Le Duan Street in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. This central venue serves as the starting point for all three race distances offered at this event, organized by Pulse Active.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the HCMC Marathon?
